(() => {if(document.querySelector('.iso-plate').textContent.includes('Apple HomeView'))throw new Error('Card mention remains');return 'Card mention removed';})()

(() => {const home=document.querySelector('#hv-panel-Home'),tile=home.querySelector('button[class*=lightTile]');if(home.getAnimations({subtree:true}).filter(a=>a.transitionProperty==='opacity').length<2)throw new Error('Background or rays did not crossfade');if(!tile.getAnimations().length)throw new Error('Tile did not animate');for(const a of document.querySelector('.iso-plate').getAnimations({subtree:true}))a.playbackRate=.2;return 'Room background, light tile, and bulb rays transition';})()
(() => {if(getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('#hv-panel-Home'),'::before').opacity!=='1')throw new Error('Rapid toggling failed');return 'Rapid toggling finishes in the correct state';})()
